display.name: Compliant (on target version)
display.description: Servers whose observed BIOS version matches the desired version (state=Completed). When this equals Total Tracked Servers, the upgrade campaign for the selected hardware is complete.

display.name: Non-Compliant (not on target version)
display.description: Servers that are pending, in-progress, or failed, plus servers with no BIOS firmware CR at all. Compliant + Non-Compliant always equals Total Tracked Servers.

spec.query: count(kube_ironcore_bmc_info{region=~"$region",buildingBlock=~"$bb",manufacturer=~"$manufacturer"} * on(name) group_left() label_replace(label_replace(metal_maintenance_biosversion_info{state!="Completed"}, "bmc", "$1", "server", "^(.*)-system-[0-9]+$"), "name", "$1", "bmc", "(.*)") or kube_ironcore_bmc_info{region=~"$region",buildingBlock=~"$bb",manufacturer=~"$manufacturer"} unless on(name) label_replace(label_replace(metal_maintenance_biosversion_info, "bmc", "$1", "server", "^(.*)-system-[0-9]+$"), "name", "$1", "bmc", "(.*)")) or vector(0)

display.name: Total Tracked Servers
display.description: Total BMC resources matching the selected manufacturer and building block. Use this as the fleet-size denominator when interpreting the Compliant and Non-Compliant counts above.

display.name: All Servers — Desired vs Observed BIOS Version
display.description: All tracked servers. Servers with a BIOS firmware CR show observed and desired versions with compliance status. Servers without a CR appear as Non-Compliant with blank version columns. Use the Model (BIOS) filter to scope to a specific hardware family.

spec.query: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(metal_maintenance_biosversion_info{model=~"$bios_model"}, "bmc", "$1", "server", "^(.*)-system-[0-9]+$") * on(bmc) group_left(region, buildingBlock, nodename, topology_kubernetes_io_zone) label_replace(kube_ironcore_bmc_info{region=~"$region",buildingBlock=~"$bb",manufacturer=~"$manufacturer"}, "bmc", "$1", "name", "(.*)"), "compliance", "Non-Compliant", "state", ".+"), "compliance", "Compliant", "state", "Completed"), "bb", "$1", "buildingBlock", "(.*)"), "zone", "$1", "topology_kubernetes_io_zone", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(kube_ironcore_bmc_info{region=~"$region",buildingBlock=~"$bb",manufacturer=~"$manufacturer"} unless on(name) label_replace(label_replace(metal_maintenance_biosversion_info, "bmc", "$1", "server", "^(.*)-system-[0-9]+$"), "name", "$1", "bmc", "(.*)"), "compliance", "Non-Compliant", "name", ".+"), "bb", "$1", "buildingBlock", "(.*)"), "zone", "$1", "topology_kubernetes_io_zone", "(.*)")
